name: ctf-dispatch
description: Triage-first CTF solving: classify a challenge, retrieve a method from a bundled Arsenal, and stop at a human checkpoint before any category solver runs.

interface.shortDescription: Triage-first CTF solving with a human checkpoint
interface.longDescription: Dispatch classifies a CTF challenge, retrieves a documented method from a bundled Arsenal of problem-pattern to method notes, and stops at a human checkpoint before any category solver runs.
